name: Sort Products in Cart & Order Lite for WooCommerce
author: kartikparmar

sections.description:
Tired of products appearing in a random order inside your WooCommerce cart and admin orders?

Sort Products in Cart & Order Lite for WooCommerce automatically arranges products in ascending or descending order — making it easier for customers to review their cart and for store owners to prepare shipments.

🔥 Free Version Features:

  • ✅ Sort cart items in Ascending (A-Z / 0-9) or Descending (Z-A / 9-0) order
  • ✅ Applies to both customer cart page and admin order details
  • ✅ Works with all regular WooCommerce product types
  • ✅ Simple toggle settings — no coding required
  • ✅ Lightweight and fast

🚀 Why Sorting Matters for Your Store:

For Customers:
– Easier to review what they’ve added
– Better shopping experience with logical product order
– Reduces cart abandonment due to confusion

For Store Owners:
– Quickly find items when preparing orders
– No more scanning randomly ordered product lists
– Faster fulfillment and fewer picking errors

🎯 Upgrade to Pro for Advanced Sorting

👉 Sort Products in Cart and Order for WooCommerce — Unlock 15+ sorting options to organize products exactly how you need.

  • Fashion stores — sort by size or color attributes

sections.installation:
Method 1: From WordPress Dashboard

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for “Sort Products in Cart & Order Lite”
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate

Method 2: Manual Upload

  1. Download sort-products-in-cart-order-lite-for-woocommerce.zip
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the zip file and click Install Now
  4. After installation, click Activate Plugin
sections.faq:
Does this work with the latest WooCommerce version?

Yes — the free version is tested with WooCommerce 9.3.3 and WordPress 6.6.2.

Can I sort by price or category?

The free version sorts by product name (ascending/descending only). Sorting by price, category, SKU, weight, attributes, and more is available in the Pro version.

Does this affect the cart for customers only?

No — it sorts products in both the customer’s cart and your admin order details.

Is HPOS / Custom Order Tables compatible?

Yes — version 1.2 added full HPOS compatibility.

Will this work with product bundles?

Yes — the Pro version supports WooCommerce Bundles products.

What if I want descending order instead of ascending?

Both free and Pro versions support ascending and descending sorting.
